findings.title: Function returns total records regardless of upload success
findings.explanation: The function always returns the length of the input list, even if some batch uploads fail or return errors. A reader cannot determine how many records were actually uploaded.
findings.suggested_fix: Track successful uploads and return that count, e.g. increment a counter inside the loop and return it instead of len(records).
findings.verdict_reason: The function uploads batches but never inspects the result of client.post and always returns the total number of input records, so callers cannot know how many were actually uploaded.

findings.title: Explicit list conversion inside loop is unnecessary
findings.explanation: `chunked` already yields iterables that can be consumed by `client.post`. Converting each batch to a list forces an intermediate list and may increase memory usage.
findings.suggested_fix: Pass `list(batch)` only if `client.post` requires a list; otherwise use the iterable directly: `client.post(..., json=batch)`
